Our Approach

RESTORE IT. DON'T REPLACE IT.

A set of good outdoor lanterns or a painted patio floor costs real money to replace. Most of the time the piece is fine and only the finish is gone.

We clean it properly, prep it, and put a fresh finish on. Same pieces, same patio, and it looks like the day it was new.

✦Cleaned and prepped before any paint
✦Even, durable finish made for outdoor use
✦Glass and details cleaned, not painted around
✦A fraction of the cost of replacing
